# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We actively support and provide security patches for the following versions:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security and integrity of this project seriously, including:
1. Web vulnerabilities (XSS, SSRF, dependency vulnerabilities).
2. Data authenticity and integrity (preventing tampered text or invalid citations).

To report a security vulnerability or critical issue:
- Open a GitHub Security Advisory or email the maintainer directly via GitHub profile: [@Bosaj](https://github.com/Bosaj).
- Please include reproduction steps, affected URLs or components, and impact analysis.
- You will receive an initial response within 48 hours.
